Autograd mechanics
Autograd mechanics
torch.autograd.Function
This note explains torch.autograd.grad and how backward works for every tensor
that records operations in the graph, so that gradients flow through the whole computation graph.
Gradients accumulate in the leaf ``.grad`` attribute unless they are cleared first.
